subject.title: feat(mattermost): read channel history with guarded permissions

question: Should Mattermost receive a read-only provider authorization bypass while reactions remain subject to the generic exact-current-conversation host gate?
rationale: This determines the permanent split between core dispatch authorization and the plugin-owned permission model; the code can mechanically preserve the host gate, but maintainers must approve the intended action boundary and default-enabled upgrade behavior.

options.title: Make the bypass read-only
options.body: Keep reactions under the existing host gate and allow the Mattermost plugin to own only the new read authorization path.

options.title: Approve provider-owned gating for all actions
options.body: Accept that Mattermost reactions as well as reads are governed by the plugin gate, with explicit tests and documented security rationale.

options.title: Pause for a broader channel-action contract decision
options.body: Defer this PR until maintainers define whether provider gates may replace host gating for non-read actions.

recommendation.title: Make the bypass read-only
recommendation.body: Keep reactions under the existing host gate and allow the Mattermost plugin to own only the new read authorization path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed Mattermost authorization implementation and can clarify or revise the plugin-side boundary before a broader owner decision.
